### Let Us Adore the Lamb
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/let-us-adore-the-lamb
Passage: Revelation 5:4
Points:
- John wept bitterly because no created being was found worthy to open the scroll of redemptive history.
- Jesus triumphed paradoxically by conquering as a Lion through submitting to slaughter as a Lamb.
- By dying on the cross, Christ earned the divine right to direct history and lead His people to victory.
- Heavenly elders fall down in adoration, holding bowls of incense that represent the prayers of believers.
- Christians should pray fervently knowing their prayers are gathered in heaven as sweet aroma before the Lamb.

### The Scroll with Seven Seals
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-scroll-with-seven-seals
Passage: Revelation 5:1-5
Points:
- The scroll held in the right hand of God contains the truth and destiny of human history.
- Just as ancient legal scrolls required authorized recipients to break the seals, this heavenly scroll required someone worthy.
- John wept because no creature in heaven, earth, or under the earth had the authority to unseal it.
- Jesus, the Lion of Judah and Root of David, triumphed and possesses the sole authority to execute God's purpose.
- God does not hide Himself from His people, but reveals His will and character through Christ.
